# Procedure Codes

This folder contains specific medical procedure codes used in the Danish healthcare system to identify and track echocardiography examinations. Drawn from both the Sygesikringsregisteret (National Health Service Register) and the Landspatientregisteret (National Patient Register), these codes serve as critical data points for the national clinical quality measurement of diagnostic practices for patients with atrial fibrillation. By standardizing how various forms of echocardiography—such as transthoracic, transesophageal, stress, and contrast-enhanced imaging—are recorded, these codes enable the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to calculate quality indicators and ensure evidence-based cardiovascular care across Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] — Sygesikringsregisteret procedure code used to track echocardiography in atrial fibrillation quality metrics.
- [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code identifying echocardiography examinations for national quality monitoring.
- [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|"3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse"]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code designating standard echocardiography examinations.
- [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|"3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse"]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code for advanced echocardiography procedures.
- [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code utilized to measure the quality of diagnostic imaging for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code identifying transesophageal echocardiography procedures.
- [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code used to track stress echocardiography for cardiovascular quality assurance.
- [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code capturing echocardiographic examinations to calculate clinical quality indicators.
- [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]] — Sygesikringsregisteret code tracking echocardiography to evaluate diagnostic workups and care standards.
- [[uxuc80|UXUC80]] — Landspatientregisteret code designating standard transthoracic echocardiography.
- [[uxuc80a|UXUC80A]] — Landspatientregisteret code for transthoracic stress echocardiography, qualifying as a completed diagnostic evaluation.
- [[uxuc80b|UXUC80B]] — Landspatientregisteret code identifying transthoracic echocardiography performed with a dobutamine test.
- [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]] — Landspatientregisteret code for contrast-enhanced transthoracic echocardiography.
- [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]] — Landspatientregisteret code designating transthoracic 3-D echocardiography.
- [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]] — Landspatientregisteret code for transthoracic echocardiography incorporating tissue Doppler imaging.
- [[uxuc81|UXUC81]] — Landspatientregisteret code identifying transesophageal echocardiography procedures.
- [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] — Landspatientregisteret code for transesophageal echocardiography performed with contrast.
